promptGuide:
CONTENT FIELD SCHEMAS — use EXACTLY these keys. * = required · (a|b) = allowed values · →kind = an id of that kind · [] = a list. Wrong keys silently orphan data.
- seed → logline*
- premise → dramatic_question*, shape:{ setup, turn1, turn2, turn3, resolution }
- pillar → controlling_idea*, ending
- character → name*, role(protagonist|antagonist|ally|love_interest|minor), want, need, wound, lie, truth, idiolect, tag
- relationship → a*→character, b*→character, bond*, charge
- world_fact → name*, rule*, mechanism, category
- location → name*, summary, sight, sound, smell, texture, mood
- thread → name*, kind(mystery|foreshadow|setup_payoff|arc), promise*, payoff
- game → name*, players[]→character, win_condition*, lose_condition*, stake, governing_rules[]→world_fact
- tentpole → summary*
- meter → name*, kind(value|game_score|affect|relationship|heat|comedy|tension|custom), poles:{ low, high }, scale:{ min(num), max(num) }, owner→undefined, target [{ at: 0..1 word%, value: number }] — the planned curve generation aims at
- voice_profile → pov(first-person|third-person-limited|third-person-omniscient|second-person), tense(past|present), style*, constraints[], sample
- act → title, goal*, turning_point, target_pct(0..1), value:{ name, from, to }
- beat → summary*, connector(therefore|but), polarity(up|down), threads [{ ref: thread id, role: setup|payoff|advance }], grounds_in [world_fact id] — the rule this turn operates on, needs [state key] this turn DEPENDS on (earned upstream), establishes [state key] this turn PRODUCES, realizes [tentpole id] this beat delivers, plays [game id] this turn advances, resolves [{ ref: game id, outcome: won|lost }], readings [{ ref: meter id, value: number }] this turn's level on each meter (a y-value)
- scene → pov→character, loc→location, goal*, conflict, outcome, value_shift:{ value, from, to, polarity(up|down) }, register, readings [{ ref: meter id, value: number }] this scene's level on each meter (inherited/refined from its beat)
